**Escopo:** Finding C1 — IDOR em rotas reports, recommendations, ods
**Arquivos modificados:**

- `backend/middleware/auth.ts` — novo middleware `requireMunicipalityScope`
- `backend/routes/reports.ts` — aplicado `requireMunicipalityScope()` em GET /:ibgeCode
- `backend/routes/recommendations.ts` — aplicado em GET /:ibgeCode e GET /:ibgeCode/scenario
- `backend/routes/ods.ts` — aplicado em GET /:ibgeCode e GET /:ibgeCode/history

**Logica:** Admin bypassa; non-admin resolve ibgeCode → municipality.id e compara com req.user.municipalityId. Log de tentativa IDOR via Winston.
